title: master-thesis-uni-li
summary: A university master's-thesis codebase that benchmarks several synthetic tabular data generation approaches (symbolic-regression denoising, standalone CTGAN, and SDV) across air-quality, credit-score, real-estate, and insurance datasets. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer is fitted per dataset and its output is scored with sdv's evaluate_quality as one of the compared generators.
